_meta.note: age_text and window_text are the admission page's words. The site gives an age only for Mini Bambolino, Bambolino, Playgroup and Prekínder; age_if_sequence (Kínder up) is NOT on the site. born_by: last birth date meeting the age at the cut-off ('1,6 años' read as 18 months). Vacancies: Vacantes 2027 PDF, which says the numbers change with movements per level. Admission fee (valor proceso): $45.000 per student.
